subject: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our conversation I attached a short scope addendum that captures the additional sub-tenants you wanted scoped into the CAIQ response (see caiq_scope_addendum.pdf).

Proposal: a timeboxed evidence intake window so your security team can drop artifacts in one place and we can do sampling/validation. Suggested window: 2027-09-15 to 2027-09-22 (we can shift by a few days if you need). During that window we will: 
- Provide a secure intake endpoint and one-time upload instructions
- Accept log samples, config screenshots, attestations and a short manifest (spreadsheet)
- Deliver a CSV manifest of what was accepted and the Redwood control mapping for each artifact (see redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx)

Questions for you before we lock the window:
1) Confirm the exact tenant IDs you want in-scope (we currently have: atlaspay-prod, atlaspay-staging).
2) Any third-party components (e.g., WAF/CDN, outsourced logging) you want separately annotated?
3) Do you require an escrow-style handoff for artifacts or is secure temporary upload sufficient?

Attachments: caiq_scope_addendum.pdf, redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx, s3_intake_instructions.txt

If the dates work I will open a secure intake ticket (ATLAS-SR-8421) and send a one-time presigned upload link and intake checklist.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Alex Green <alex.green@atlaspay.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasPay Security Team <security@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — the proposed approach makes sense. We do have an internal compliance blackout the week of 9/15, so could we shift the intake to 2027-09-16 through 2027-09-20? That gives us one day buffer after our internal change window.

Confirming in-scope tenants: atlaspay-prod, atlaspay-test (not staging — test is the environment we want included).
Third-party list: FastCDN (cdn.fastcdn.com) and LogFlow (logflow.io) — both are managed SaaS but wed like them annotated in the CAIQ responses.

We prefer a temporary secure upload (presigned S3 or your secure portal) rather than escrow. Please add a single Redwood POC for intake questions — Ill loop them into our Jira ticket ATLAS-SR-8421.

Alex Green
Security Engineering Manager
AtlasPay
alex.green@atlaspay.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window

Alex —

Thanks, that window (2027-09-16 to 2027-09-20) works for us. Ive updated the scope addendum to replace "staging" with "test" and to call out FastCDN and LogFlow as third-party components; new PDF attached.

Intake plan (short):
- Intake URL: https://redwood-secure.example.com/intake/ATLAS/8421
- Upload method: presigned S3 links generated per artifact (instructions attached: s3_intake_instructions.txt). Links expire after 24 hours.
- Required manifest: one row per artifact with artifact_type, file_name, control_refs (CSA IDs), owner_contact, and timestamp. Template is included in redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx.
- Sampling: we will request up to 5 representative log/config samples per control family for runtime controls, and a broader sample for policy/process docs.

Owners on our side: Marissa Cole (technical evidence intake & sampling) and Kimberly Park (control mapping and narrative stitching). Marissa/Kimberly, can you confirm availability for the 9/16-9/20 window?

Next steps after intake: we will produce an annotated CAIQ response, a manifest of artifacts, and an owner-attested summary for your audit team.

Naomi

Attachments: updated_caiq_scope_addendum.pdf, redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx, s3_intake_instructions.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window

Naomi / Kimberly —

Im available for the 9/16-9/20 window. Plan: Ill triage incoming artifacts on day 1, confirm manifest completeness by EOD 9/17, and produce a sampling manifest by 9/18. Kimberly, Ill hand off any mapping questions to you for clarification on control traces.

Ill also prepare a short intake-runbook so AtlasPay knows naming conventions and preferred screenshot types (will upload to the intake ticket).

-Marissa
Senior Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Green <alex.green@atlaspay.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasPay Security Team <security@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope addendum & evidence window

Naomi / Marissa / Kimberly —

All good from our side. We accept the 2027-09-16 to 2027-09-20 intake window and will start collecting artifacts. Ill attach our internal SLA addendum and a pointer to our SOC2 attestation once available (likely next week).

Attachments we will upload to the intake portal: atlas_sla_addendum.pdf, and later the SOC2 attestations.

Thanks for coordinating. Ill keep ATLAS-SR-8421 updated and will tag Naomi as the Redwood POC.

Alex
